description: 1∶50 000 Engineering Geological Survey and Geotechnical Test Dataset of the Doumen Map-Sheet in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is a data set described in the paper "1∶50 000 Engineering Geological Survey and Geotechnical Test Dataset of the Doumen Map-Sheet in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2019), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). This dataset was created as a result of the " Environmental Geological Survey (1∶50 000) in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area” project of the China Geological Survey in 2017. Coverage: the Doumen map sheet in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, China, at 1:50,000. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support engineering geological suitability for construction. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
